summary: English auction with instant outbid refunds, pull-based cancellations, finalisation and an early-bird bonus draw.

defects.title: Compulsory instant refund lets a bidder block all bids
defects.description: bid() refunds the previous top bidder with a call whose success is required; a bidder contract that reverts on receive makes every subsequent bid revert.
defects.trigger: A contract that reverts in receive() becomes highest bidder, then anyone else calls bid().
defects.observed: The competing bid fails and the reverting bidder remains highestBidder.

defects.title: Withdraw sends pendingReturns before zeroing them
defects.description: withdraw() pays pendingReturns[msg.sender] via call and only zeroes the balance afterwards, so a receiver can re-enter and pull the same pending amount repeatedly.
defects.trigger: A contract with pendingReturns calls withdraw(); its receive() re-enters withdraw().
defects.observed: Receiver pulls 4x its entitled pending amount, draining other bidders' returns.

defects.title: finalize can be called repeatedly
defects.description: finalize() never records that the auction settled, so it can be called again and pays the seller highestBid a second time out of other bidders' funds.
defects.trigger: Call finalize() twice after the auction ends (with extra balance in the contract).
defects.observed: seller balance grows by 2 * highestBid = 20 ETH.

defects.title: Bids accepted 15 minutes past the advertised end
defects.description: bid() accepts bids while block.timestamp <= endTime + LATE_BID_GRACE (or block.number <= endBlock), so bids still land after the published end time and after hasEnded() is already true.
defects.trigger: Warp 10 minutes past endTime, roll past endBlock, then call bid().
defects.observed: A 2 ETH bid is accepted 600s past endTime while hasEnded() already returns true.

defects.title: Minimum increment divides before multiplying
defects.description: minNextBid() computes highestBid / BPS * minIncrementBps; for bids under 10,000 wei the increment rounds to 0 and an equal bid outbids.
defects.trigger: Highest bid is 5000 wei with a 500 bps increment; next bidder bids exactly 5000 wei.
defects.observed: minNextBid stays 5000 and an equal bid becomes the new highest.

defects.title: Highest bidder can cancel without losing top status
defects.description: cancelBid() refunds the caller's bidOf entry into pendingReturns but never clears highestBidder/highestBid, so the top bidder can take its bid back and still have the seller paid highestBid at finalize.
defects.trigger: Highest bidder calls cancelBid() then withdraw(); finalize() runs after the auction ends.
defects.observed: The seller is still paid 10 ETH while the contract balance drops to 0, draining the funded bonus pool.

defects.title: init() is callable by anyone
defects.description: init() is guarded only by the initialized flag, so after deployment anyone can front-run the real setup and make themselves the seller with their own parameters.
defects.trigger: A third party calls init() before the deployer does.

defects.title: endTime wraps on huge durations
defects.description: endTime is stored as uint64 in an unchecked cast; a duration of 2^256-1 wraps endTime to timestamp 0, so the auction counts as ended as soon as the block clock catches up.
defects.observed: endTime is 0 (wrapped) at deployment; once block.number is rolled past endBlock, hasEnded() is already true.

defects.title: Private reserve price readable from storage
defects.description: reservePrice is kept in a private variable and enforced at finalize, but anyone can read slot 0 of the deployed contract and learn the exact reserve.
defects.trigger: Read storage slot 0 of the auction contract.
defects.observed: The loaded value equals the configured reservePrice.

defects.title: Bonus draw seed derived from block data
defects.description: drawEarlyBirdBonus() picks the winner via keccak256(block.timestamp, block.prevrandao, n) % n; a contract recomputes the same index on-chain and only calls when the winner is itself.
defects.trigger: An early-bidder contract waits for a block whose predicted index is itself, then calls drawEarlyBirdBonus().
defects.observed: The bonus pool is paid to the computing contract on a winning block.

defects.title: Outbid bidder's bid record is never cleared
defects.description: bid() refunds the previous highest bidder with a call but only writes bidOf[msg.sender]; the outbid bidder's bidOf entry stays live, so they can cancelBid() and withdraw() the same bid a second time out of other bidders' or the seller's funds.
defects.trigger: A bids 1.5 ETH, B bids 2 ETH (A is refunded), then A calls cancelBid() and withdraw().
defects.observed: A receives 3 ETH total (1.5 ETH instant refund + 1.5 ETH pendingReturns) for a 1.5 ETH deposit.
